rationale: A bounded number of physical controller attempts is an immutable campaign decision needed to govern recovery of the single active controller Job. It is distinct from per-trial execution limits and has already been clarified from the ambiguous max_attempts name.
alternatives: Remove it and allow unbounded controller recovery.
Merge it with recovery_policy.max_physical_executions_per_trial, which would conflate controller and trial execution lifecycles.
simplestChoice: Keep max_controller_attempts as an optional positive integer in controller_policy.
